title: Clearline: incident postmortem and QBR

sentences.speaker: Ben Okafor
sentences.text: Our first reply during the outage took nine hours. Our own customers were on the phone.

sentences.speaker: Dana Whitaker
sentences.text: I apologise. There was no priority queue for P1 tickets.

sentences.speaker: Ben Okafor
sentences.text: We need a written SLA. One hour response on P1, in the contract.

sentences.speaker: Ben Okafor
sentences.text: And the webhooks. They dropped silently. We found out from our customers, not from you.

sentences.speaker: Sam Ito
sentences.text: We don't retry failed webhooks today. That is something we should fix.

sentences.speaker: Dana Whitaker
sentences.text: We'll put the one-hour P1 response into the renewal, effective the middle of January.

summary: Clearline wants a contractual 1-hour P1 response SLA from mid-January 2027 and reliable webhooks with retries after a silent-drop incident.
action_items: Dana to add 1h P1 SLA to renewal effective 15 Jan 2027
Sam to log webhook retry gap as a product issue
